research_question: RQ1: Does math-domain instruction tuning improve code evaluation performance?
hypothesis: QLoRA training on the Atlas math domain yields positive cross-domain transfer to the code domain (delta_cross^{M->C} >= +0.05) with improved per-example count exceeding regressed count on code_eval_v1.
expected_outcome: Positive / neutral / negative transfer classified per research protocol v1.1 section 8.3; transfer ratio TR_{M->C} when in-domain gain is positive, otherwise N/A (HOLD).

dataset.selection_method: ascending sha256(seed:record_id), first 400 eligible math records

approval_note: P8-A training + code_eval_v1 evaluation authorized by mission directive 2026-08-05. P8-B is NOT authorized; wait for architecture review.
evaluation_scope: code_eval_v1 ONLY (N=100), frozen QEE v2. In-domain math evaluation is out of scope; transfer ratio TR_{M->C} is reported N/A (HOLD) because delta_in^M cannot be measured without math evaluation.

baseline.note: Baseline recorded on the exact code_eval_v1 split with the same inference config (greedy, NF4+bf16).
